# 字体

## 1. 字体上传

第一次上传字体，请按以下操作：

1. 点击"作品上传"，左侧导航栏选择字体，点击"创建作品"，选择字体类型，完善字体基本信息，点击"确定"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110722.27480109330686514610140764445366:50001231000000:2800:D4BC03F62F4DF8BE90492FEE12A473589990054A75A2BBFFCF23093D40A7FB0B.png "点击放大")

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110722.45679949661991275329041866958949:50001231000000:2800:2EF6266AD2C9355B393B40B543172AA98AACD1909B5E80473DA0CE2E48D5B6BE.png "点击放大")
   > 说明
   >
   > 可变字体与静态字体上传方式一致。

2. 点击"上传字体包"， 上传字体包，完善字体包信息，点击"确定"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110722.71986780584726706262000463817408:50001231000000:2800:2993F8BDAECB3EFCBDA19F81325276A9418826ED280BB4C59CC779E66639FC04.png "点击放大")

3. 选中成功上传的字体包，上传版权文件。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110722.40350696429746027421652538295059:50001231000000:2800:951E18F3A19586CADC00277637E530645B4646ABEB731361769E7E485800855D.png "点击放大")

4. 填写基本属性、付费设置、分发国家及区域、标签设置、发布等信息，点击下一步。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110722.74012380344369840640329888318848:50001231000000:2800:660AF2533E5F5FAD79DCF374066121717E164E5A159D59B2E82A4B43013B5F95.png "点击放大")

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.04333401545665624826991638840902:50001231000000:2800:BCF458D2CDC30C4FCB69F86678849E00E7995EE00D2C80CDEF9EF98329524B89.png "点击放大")

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.80803823584558442668820300254430:50001231000000:2800:C6FC48BA769AAC824DAC1EDD8175C36776CBBF5FA7C5210B73F0BB50CB122605.png "点击放大")

5. 信息确认无误后，点击"提交"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.83736562085267039021599748163397:50001231000000:2800:E3B4BB74E23F22FE825E54D43FC6762E3C658B5B2138ED36F26282E0A7903B52.png "点击放大")

6. 作品列表页对应作品的状态显示为"审核中"，表示上传成功。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.25928857449034000350741966908321:50001231000000:2800:09138C052487638BCF9156705460A3609D1236A6071FCB2371A681348D95BFBC.png "点击放大")

## 2. 字体升级

1. 在"我的作品"页找到需要升级的字体作品，点击"升级"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.42860388659751116827846108716460:50001231000000:2800:FC5124332C0AC4D4C7F48911CAF3E69389767301D3912A4EF056102DE0BF0BB8.png "点击放大")

2. 点击"上传字体包"，上传准备好的字体包。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.58472623367412948161519159506324:50001231000000:2800:19097BA2484077C5843F1F6AA444146ADB1A253E6BA1C59A895FD994894621EB.png "点击放大")

3. 上传成功后，选中新上传的字体包，付费设置不允许修改，勾选更新类型，点击"下一步"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.27236210565411297436247207720971:50001231000000:2800:C200162D5F608A239CC2C4B3F434D6CCF785B5FB429964E5A7C5D927FEE34E68.png "点击放大")

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.87334508194797325448312888687552:50001231000000:2800:5702707F04E0B71B9CE404AE6830E9A31D1548A282765B135D0E77D95C777D3B.png "点击放大")

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.39108855238267589208409234945366:50001231000000:2800:DFB836F0926480543293EF8820AEF9DB0A46D7F3B7C0ED1D56A7BF08BF148253.png "点击放大")

4. 信息确认无误后，点击"提交"。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.87951739792931654046620311019500:50001231000000:2800:ED4EFFA120EDF9A380AA82A0D4EABA8280A22A2BD907B1770772E067070CA571.png "点击放大")

5. 作品页对应作品的状态显示为"升级中"，表示上传成功。

   ![](https://communityfile-drcn.op.dbankcloud.cn/FileServer/getFile/cmtyPub/011/111/111/0000000000011111111.20250620110723.91130245393566651175321361900429:50001231000000:2800:C2CC9FBFCD242003B64A03B384BDE58431E67311855A91D7D78C9563A27F6DE3.png "点击放大")
